_comment: Per-app restart overrides for the VPN Routes widget. Keys are the app name shown in the widget (case-insensitive) or its exclude path. 'stop' = command used instead of SIGTERM, 'launch' = command used instead of the original command line, 'block_if' = regex; if any running process's command line matches, the restart is refused. 'timeout' = seconds to wait for the app to quit.

Steam.block_message: A Steam game is running; close it first.

Spotify._why: Spotify catches SIGTERM and keeps running; quit it over MPRIS instead
